title: The Last Ghost Anew
author: Noor Montrose
blurb: Noor Marchetti, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
